description: This file contains TypeScript code for managing AI roadmaps, including data interfaces, functions for fetching and generating roadmaps, stream handling, and user roadmap listing.

classes.name: AIRoadmapDocument
classes.description: Interface representing an AI roadmap document with metadata and optional question and answers.

classes.name: AIRoadmapResponse
classes.description: Type extending AIRoadmapDocument with optional SVG HTML content.

classes.name: RoadmapDetails
classes.description: Type representing details of a specific roadmap, including IDs and title.

classes.name: GenerateAIRoadmapOptions
classes.description: Type defining options for generating an AI roadmap, including callbacks and parameters.

classes.name: ListUserAiRoadmapsQuery
classes.description: Type for query parameters when listing user AI roadmaps.

classes.name: ListUserAiRoadmapsResponse
classes.description: Type for response data when listing user AI roadmaps.

methods.name: aiRoadmapOptions
methods.description: Fetches AI roadmap data and generates SVG visualization.

methods.name: generateAIRoadmap
methods.description: Generates or regenerates an AI roadmap, handling streaming responses and callbacks.

methods.name: listUserAiRoadmapsOptions
methods.description: Fetches list of user AI roadmaps with pagination and query options.
